channel.title: Made in Minnesota - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Made in Minnesota (minnesotasnewcountry.com)

item.title: Country Legend Back In The Northland This Summer
item.description: Country music fans, mark your calendars for June 5th as Dwight Yoakam takes the stage at Black Bear Casino Resort!

item.title: Tips For Securing Your Home From Hungry Bears This Spring
item.description: As bears shake off winter in Minnesota, they're in search of food. Residents should follow these tips to keep yard bear-free.

item.title: Minnesota Lawmakers Vote To End Housing Program Amid Ongoing Scrutiny Over Fraud
item.description: In a unanimous vote, Minnesota's House of Representatives decided to scrap the Housing Stabilization Services program amid alarming fraud investigations that have led to $243 million in withheld Medicaid funds.

item.title: Cody Johnson Shares His Initial Reaction to Kid Rock's ''Til You Can't'
item.description: When Kid Rock first wanted to cut a version of ''Til You Can't,' Cody Johnson's response was, 'Well, maybe.' But after getting the blessing of the songwriters, and hearing why Rock wanted to record the song, he was sold.

item.title: You Could Join Activists And Leaders At The St. Paul Rally On March 28
item.description: The No Kings rally kicks off Saturday at Harriet Island, bringing together voices like Joan Baez and Bernie Sanders to rally for change at the State Capitol.

item.title: Navigating Four-way Stops In St. Cloud: A Familiar Dance Of Patience, Confusion & Distraction
item.description: St. Cloud drivers are facing daily frustrations at four-way stops, where cars often sit in confusion, with distracted driving making the wait even longer at traffic signals.

item.title: Fast-paced Panel Discussion With 4 Mystery Authors At Great River Libraries This Week
item.description: Mystery fans are in for a treat at the Great River Regional Library, where acclaimed authors reveal their writing secrets and engage in lively discussions through all week long through Saturday!

item.title: $2.5 Million Grant Boosts Highway 15 Improvements In St. Cloud
item.description: St. Cloud's Highway 15 is getting a $2.5 million boost for improvements, focusing on safer, faster travel with new median U-turn intersections and thorough planning for a better commute.

item.title: Authorities Give Update on Investigation into Fire That Took The Lives of Jessi Pierce, Her Children & Their Dog
item.description: A devastating fire in White Bear Lake took the lives of sports personality Jessi Pierce, her three children, and their dog, leaving the community in mourning and supporting her husband, Mike.

item.title: Chevy Express Van Collides With Parked Box Truck in Eden Lake Township
item.description: A morning crash in Eden Lake Township pinned a driver inside his van after colliding with a parked box truck, but thankfully he only suffered minor injuries.
